title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(建築学科)
subtitle: Design Project III
keywords: Architectural design 2.Architectural planning 3.Urban design 4.Location and regional cooperation
educationalGoal: The purpose of this course is to develop a higher level of specialized knowledge in the fields of architecture and cities to develop the ability to apply it in practice. Students should acquire the ability to discover and solve problems in architectural disciplines through project activities that will become the core of real-world activities in the future.
advice: The educational goals of the architectural design department are as follows. (1) Development of the students' ability to plan, design, and operate beautiful and functional architectural spaces while studying a wide range of specialized basic knowledge on architecture and considering economics and productivity. (2) Development of the talented human resources who have advanced expertise and design ability that can plan and design human environment at various levels, from interior, housing and architecture to urban development in today's world where the formation of rich, beautiful and sustainable architecture and local environments are required. Design Project III is the final subject of this department. In this subject, (1) Students should further develop the theme independently based on activities at Preparatory Seminar. (2) Students should receive the advice of their supervisor and experience the process of finding and solving problems while deepening the project theme. (3) Students should understand the learning goals and action goals and execute the project based on the learning support plan prepared for each laboratory.

activityGoals.body: Students can combine expertise, find problems, and plan solutions through project activities.
Students can logically organize the process from finding a problem to solving it, and create a report about it.
Students can solve problems through team activities and independently develop project themes.

lessons.content: (1)Students promote the activities while receiving advice from the supervisor based on the theme set in Deign Project III. (2)Students conduct research, analysis, planning, etc. within the framework of activities set for each laboratory. (3)Students make presentations at interim presentations and public presentation review set up by the department, and receive evaluations.
